children: Nissan Motor aims to produce about one million vehicles annually in Japan in the long run.
The Japanese carmaker said Thursday that it plans to grow its business in Japan and expand exports through a broader product offering and changes in manufacturing footprint.
For the fiscal year ended March, its production in Japan dropped 13% to about 558,000 vehicles as sales slump continued.
